before-6am.title: Before 6AM cafes
before-6am.titleWithCount: {count} cafes open before 6AM in Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan
before-6am.description: Find cafes that open before 6 in the morning across Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan.
before-6am.intro: Pre-work coffee, post-dawn run brunch, early meetings — there are more reasons to need a cafe before 6AM than you'd think. We've gathered earlybird cafes across {count} areas.
before-6am.tip: Early morning cafes may have different hours on different days. Always check before visiting.

open-by-7am.title: Open by 7 AM
open-by-7am.description: Cafes in Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan that open before 7 AM — perfect for a coffee on your commute.
open-by-7am.intro: Need a coffee before work? We found cafes opening before 7 AM across {count} areas in Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan.
open-by-7am.tip: Chain locations can differ in opening hours — check the specific branch before visiting.

24h-cafes.title: 24-hour cafes
24h-cafes.description: Open around the clock — 24-hour cafes in Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan for late nights and early mornings.
24h-cafes.intro: Late-night study sessions, after-work wind-downs, dawn coffee runs. Here are {count} cafes open 24/7 with no time restrictions.
24h-cafes.tip: Even 24-hour cafes may adjust hours on weekends or holidays.

new-cafes.title: Newly added cafes
new-cafes.description: Check out morning cafes added in the past 7 days.
new-cafes.intro: Discover freshly added cafes on Morning Cafe. Why not try a new morning routine?
new-cafes.tip: Newly listed cafes may not have reviews yet. Be the first to visit and leave one!

weekend-morning.title: Weekend morning cafes
weekend-morning.description: Morning cafes open before 8AM on Saturdays and Sundays in Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan.
weekend-morning.intro: A lazy weekend morning, a walk to a neighborhood cafe for a cup of coffee. We found cafes that open before 8AM on Sat or Sun across {count} areas.
weekend-morning.tip: Weekend hours often differ from weekdays. Check Saturday and Sunday hours separately.

sunday-morning.title: Sunday Morning Cafes
sunday-morning.description: Many cafes close on Sundays — these Seoul, Gyeonggi & Busan cafes open before 8 AM on Sunday.
sunday-morning.intro: Sunday mornings are the hardest time to find an open cafe. We found cafes open before 8 AM on Sundays across {count} areas.
sunday-morning.tip: Some cafes open later or take alternate Sundays off — calling ahead is safest.
